data.title: What defenders need to know about ARTEX, the agentic AI framework threat actors abuse | Microsoft Security Blog
data.description: The AI-powered penetration testing framework ARTEX has been abused by threat actors like Storm-0940, Storm-3358, Onyx Sleet, Pearl Sleet, Crystal Typhoon, and Salt Typhoon to accelerate their existing workflows related to network reconnaissance, credential attacks, and web application exploitation.
data.author: Microsoft Threat Intelligence
